description: grok-cli: braille spinner carrying an elapsed '2.5s' + '[stop]' + an 'Esc:cancel' footer -> generating; after the turn the footer drops Esc:cancel, the composer is an empty '>' and 'Worked for 7.9s' is chrome -> idle. Frames captured from grok 1.0.4 via node-pty.

anchors.name: tool active
anchors.notes: All three live-turn cues are present: braille glyph + elapsed seconds, the [stop] control, and the Esc:cancel footer hint.

anchors.name: settled prompt
anchors.notes: 'Worked for 7.9s' must NOT read as a spinner: it has no braille glyph and no trailing ellipsis. Note the replay buffer ACCUMULATES while a real TUI repaints, so the completed turn's own output is included here to push the earlier spinner frame out of the spinner scope window (scopeWindowLines 14) exactly as a real terminal would.
